rendered: The surface V2O5 film thicknesses tested electrochemically were ∼80 nm[1] and ∼40 nm[2] (the thinner film's data are in the Supporting Information). The thicker film, the about-80 nm coating used for the cyclic voltammetry and Raman work, was grown with 1000 ALD cycles[3]. The thinner film came from 500[4] ALD cycles, as shown in the thickness plot of Fig. 1[5]. The potential shifts did not differ meaningfully: both films showed a potential shift of about ∼40 mV[6], and similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed[7] for the films, owing to their similar locked-in elastic strains.
